ac-1900w-port-side-exhaust.description: Dual NXA-PAC-1900W-PE supplies and three NXA-SFAN-30CFM-PE fan modules: port-side exhaust airflow, blue latches. This guide lists the exhaust 1900 W supply. The component's own guide lists none, so the build is an attribute override of it.

ac-1900w-port-side-intake.description: Dual NXA-PAC-1900W-PI supplies and three NXA-SFAN-30CFM-PI fan modules: port-side intake airflow, burgundy latches. The 1900 W supply is the one the PoE paragraph names.

ac-350w-port-side-exhaust.description: Dual NXA-PAC-350W-PE2 supplies and three NXA-SFAN-30CFM-PE fan modules: port-side exhaust airflow, blue latches. The guide's Overview gives the colours.

ac-350w-port-side-intake.description: Dual NXA-PAC-350W-PI2 supplies and three NXA-SFAN-30CFM-PI fan modules: port-side intake airflow, burgundy latches

dc-440w-port-side-intake.description: Dual NXA-PDC-440W-PI DC supplies and three NXA-SFAN-30CFM-PI fan modules: port-side intake airflow, burgundy latches

hvac-hvdc-350w-port-side-exhaust.description: Dual NXA-PHV-350W-PE HVAC/HVDC supplies and three NXA-SFAN-30CFM-PE fan modules: port-side exhaust airflow, blue latches

hvac-hvdc-350w-port-side-intake.description: Dual NXA-PHV-350W-PI HVAC/HVDC supplies and three NXA-SFAN-30CFM-PI fan modules: port-side intake airflow, burgundy latches

description: 48x copper PoE/PoE+/PoE++ access (40 at 10M/100M/1G and 8 at 10M/100M), 4x 10/25G SFP28 and 2x 40/100G QSFP28 uplink 1RU data-centre switch running NX-OS. The port side carries all fifty-four ports and the BCN, STS, ENV and P lamps. The other side carries the console, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port, the USB port, three fan modules and two power supplies. Ports number 1-54 and run DOWN each column, odd on the top row. Ships port-side intake (burgundy modules) or port-side exhaust (blue).

gaps.note: The front figure draws a column of seven rings at the right end beside the QSFP28 pair and a block of nine rings under the lamp panel. Callout 1 is "LEDs" and the text names no others, and appendix C lists the BCN, STS, ENV and PoE lamps and the port lamps only. They are drawn as marks without a state.
gaps.wanted: What the sixteen rings are, and whether they are lamps.

gaps.note: The guide's rear figure (art 504861, PDF p9) is the N9348GC-FX3's, by the guide's own sentence and by the identical bitmap. It shows AC supplies of the 350 W kind and no 1900 W supply, and nothing in it is specific to the PoE model.
gaps.wanted: A rear drawing of the PH itself, and a picture of its 1900 W supply.

gaps.note: The guide states no default build among its eight supply and airflow combinations. The configuration `ac-350w-port-side-intake` is the base, as for the 9348GC-FX3, so that a plain chassis lists with the family's first supply; it is a choice, not a statement of the guide.
gaps.wanted: Which combination Cisco ships by default.

gaps.note: The guide's supply list allows "a mix of AC and DC power sources" but not a mix of airflow directions. A configuration seats one supply type in both bays, so a mixed build (for instance a 1900 W AC beside a 440 W DC) is not written as a configuration. The bays accept every listed supply, so a user can seat the mix by hand.
gaps.wanted: Which mixed pairs Cisco supports, and for how long, if that is limited.

gaps.note: The Overview says how many 1900 W supplies 48 and 21 PoE++ (60 W) ports need and prints no PoE budget in watts, per supply or per chassis; none is carried.
gaps.wanted: The PoE power budget of the chassis with one and with two of each supply.

gaps.note: The installation options (PDF p23, printed 17) also name the N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT, with no contents and no procedure. NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU (appendix D, PDF p65, printed 59) and NXK-ACC-KIT2-2RU (install procedure, PDF p29, printed 23) have procedures and are on main as cisco/nxk-acc-kit-1ru@1 and cisco/nxk-acc-kit2-2ru@1; the third is not modelled.
gaps.wanted: The contents or procedure of the N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT.

A drawing of the lid, the underside and the two side walls. The guide's overview shows the chassis only in the two flat views and calls out the grounding pad; no side wall is drawn and none can be measured.

A picture of the 1900 W AC, the 350 W PHV and the 440 W DC supplies. The guide's figure shows AC supplies only ("AC power supplies shown"). Their faces are the 350 W AC supply's with the inlet changed.
A stated size for the supplies and the fan module. The guide gives "Form factor RSP1" for the 350 W AC and PHV supplies and nothing for the others or for the fan.
A cage skin with a bail. The library's SFP cage has one skin and none shows a bail.

gaps.note: The Overview says the switch "will power down due to a fan-policy trigger if fewer than 2 fans are operational", and that with more than one rotor failed it "will issue a warning and power down in 2 minute".
gaps.wanted: Whether the first sentence counts fan modules or rotors. It is read as modules, two of three, so the group says 2+1.

attrs.redundancy-note: Installation guide, Overview: three fan modules of two rotors each. The switch "will power down due to a fan-policy trigger if fewer than 2 fans are operational". It works with one rotor failed in any one module and, with more than one rotor failed, warns and powers down in two minutes.

mgmt.mixed: the out-of-band block at the left end: an RJ-45 console port, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port and a USB port. Three media, one purpose: reaching the switch when the data plane cannot.

attrs.redundancy-note: installation guide: "Power supply modules (two-one for operations and one for redundancy [1+1])". Slot 1 is on the left and slot 2 on the right.

name: n9k-c9348gc-fx3ph

chassis-lamps.note: Callout 1 is "LEDs". The figure draws a boxed panel at the left end with four ring lamps in a column, legends BCN, STS, ENV and P to their left, at 10.6 mm across and 11.7, 15.6, 19.6 and 23.5 mm down. The P lamp is read as the PoE lamp: Appendix C (PDF p62, printed 56) lists a "PoE" row, green "PoE mode is operational", amber "Any fault, or power that is denied on PoE ports because providing power exceeds the switch power capacity" and off "PoE is disabled", under a heading that reads "Fan Module LEDs" because the table runs over a page, and the sentence naming the lamps ("The BCN, STS, and ENV, LEDs") does not name P. The figure's legend and the table's row are the evidence for the reading. The same table has a "(GPS)" row that no figure here draws. Under the panel the figure draws a block of nine small rings in three rows and a mark; the guide does not name them and they are drawn as marks. The figure also draws a column of seven rings at the right end, beside the QSFP28 pair; they are drawn as marks and are in the gaps. The mark is the maker's logo; none is drawn, as the library's practice for a Cisco face is no logo artwork. The model legend under the uplinks, CISCO NEXUS N9K-C9348GC-FX3PH, is printed on the figure and is carried as text.

colour.note: NO SOURCE FOR THE COLOUR. The guide's figures are uncoloured line art. #d0d2cf is the value the 93180YC-EX's stencil sample gave, carried across as a family colour.

gate-1.note: The front figure's body, between its outermost end lines on the 400 dpi render of PDF p8, is 2344 px across and 235 px down: aspect 9.97 against the guide's 17.3 x 1.72 in, 10.06, so 0.9% out, and it can be measured; 5.33 px per mm across from 439.4 mm and 5.38 down from 43.7. A repeated feature checks the scale: the jack columns step 74.5 px, 13.97 mm, against the registry's 13.97, so every pitch is the registry's and the figure fixes where each group starts. The rear figure's body is 2344 px across and 234 down, 10.02, 5.33 px per mm. The origin is the outermost end line on the left (the body outline is drawn double, 1.2 to 1.5 mm apart); the merged 9348GC-FX3 reads its positions from an inner line, so the same bitmap's left-end positions here are 1.2 mm further right.

port-lamps.note: Appendix C, Switch Chassis LEDs (PDF p61, printed 55): "The port LEDs appear as triangles pointing up or down to the nearest port." Green is admin up, module present and link up; amber is admin down or module absent; off is up and present but no link. The figure draws the SFP28 triangles large, between the two cage rows, and the QSFP28 triangles at the ends of a band with eight small windows between them; the windows are drawn as marks and carry no state. The copper triangles are the printed arrows beside the numerals; the copper lamps are the rectangles under the jacks.

port-order.note: The figure prints a pair of numerals over each column of lamps with an up and a down triangle between them, "1 up down 2" to "47 up down 48", and "49 up down 50", "51 up down 52" and "53 up down 54" under the SFP28 and QSFP28 cages, so the odd port is the upper jack or cage. The Overview (PDF p7) gives 40 10M/100M/1G and 8 10M/100M copper downlink ports that support PoE, PoE+ and PoE++, 4 SFP28 uplinks and 2 QSFP28 uplinks, and the callout table (PDF p8) gives "100M/1G RJ45 ports (40)" and "100M RJ45 ports (8)". The Overview note says "Ports 41-48 support 10M/100M half-duplex only", and the figure marks ports 41 to 48 with a shaded band above their jacks and a shaded strip behind their numerals, so the first 40 are ports 1 to 40. Port numbers are as printed; the NX-OS interface names are not in the guide.

port-rates.note: Ports 1-40 take the group's rate, 1g (10M/100M/1G). Ports 41-48 state `speed: 100m` and a `rate-note` of their own: the guide says they support 10M/100M half-duplex only. The DCIM export types them 100base-tx.

power.note: Appendix B, Switch Power Input Requirements (PDF p55, printed 49, read from the page): typical 238 W and maximum 251 W "(AC or DC)", 856.447 BTU per hour. The figures are the switch's draw and not a supply rating; the guide names no configuration or ambient. The Overview (PDF p8, printed 2) says "48 PoE++ (60W ports) - two 1900W power supplies needed", "21 PoE++ (60W ports) - one 1900W power supplies needed" and "Non-PoE - one or two 350W power supplies needed". No table prints a PoE budget, so none is carried.

rack-ears.note: The guide's NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU procedure says the holes used depend on the rack and on the clearance needed for interface cables, 3 inches minimum, and for module handles, 1 inch minimum, and its figure shows two ways to mount the brackets. None dimensions a position and none says which the box ships with, so the two positions are written without an `at`, named for what the text says they clear, and none is the default.

rear-face.note: Every x and y on the module side is read off the rear figure (5.33 px per mm across, 5.36 down, origin the outermost end line). The console jack over the RJ-45 management jack, the USB port stood on end, the SFP management port, two lamps labelled BCN and STS, a grounding symbol with two screws, three fan modules, then supply 1 and supply 2. THE OUT-OF-BAND BLOCK IS AT THE LEFT END, as on the 93180YC-EX. The figure draws small airflow legends, F1 and F2 with arrows, beside the first fan and P1 and P2 beside the supplies; they are not carried. The management SFP cage is the registry's plain one. The grounding pad is drawn as the plain earth symbol; the registry's ground symbol is the circled one, so the mark is drawn.

rear-figure.note: THE REAR FIGURE IS THE 9348GC-FX3's. Art number 504861, PDF p9 (printed 3), the page whose text under the callout table says "The figure shows the Cisco N9348GC-FX3 switch." The embedded bitmap is pixel for pixel the one in the N9348GC-FX3 guide's rear figure (the same 1820 x 412 image and mask, compared after extraction), so the two guides' drawings agree exactly. This guide holds no rear figure drawn for the PH: the callout list is the PH's (3 power supply modules, 1 or 2) and the figure is the sibling's. The rear is drawn from the figure, as a reading of this guide, and the gap says what is not shown.

shaded-ports.note: The figure draws ports 41 to 48 (callout 5) shaded: a dark band above the upper jacks of the last four columns, 53.8 mm long, and a strip behind their numerals. They are decor, on the panel, in a mid grey that keeps the dark numerals readable on both stages. The guide's text gives the reason only as the half-duplex note.

sources.note: One guide, held as PDF and as converted text and figures; it is not committed. Cisco N9348GC-FX3PH NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, 66 pages, First Published 2023-08-18, Last Modified 2026-07-22 (the figures were read from the PDF pages themselves, rendered at 400 dpi, and the text from its text layer). Page numbers are PDF pages with the printed page after them. The Overview (PDF p7, printed 1) and its front and rear figures (PDF p8 and p9, printed 2 and 3; art numbers 504860 and 504861), appendix B (PDF p54, printed 48, and PDF p55, printed 49), appendix C (PDF p61, printed 55) and appendix D. THE FRONT FIGURE IS CLEAN FLAT LINE ART, a 1821 px bitmap, about 4 px per mm, with callouts. NO DATA SHEET, PHOTOGRAPH, 3D MODEL OR STENCIL IS HELD for this model, and the NetBox devicetype-library is held as a path listing only: no file was read, so nothing is taken from it.

stack-orientation.note: The library's convention: the upper cage upright over the lower turned 180, and the upper jack turned 180 over the lower one. The front figure draws the upper jacks with their latch notch up and the lower jacks with the notch down, which is that arrangement.

supply-1900w.note: THIS GUIDE CONTRADICTS cisco/nxa-pac-1900w@1 in two places, and the component is not edited. (1) The Overview (PDF p8, printed 2) and the weights table (PDF p54, printed 48) list both NXA-PAC-1900W-PI (port-side intake, burgundy) and NXA-PAC-1900W-PE (port-side exhaust, blue); the component says the FX3P guide "lists no port-side exhaust version". The exhaust build here is written with component-attrs (the airflow and the latch colour of the configuration), as the exhaust builds of the 350 W, PHV and 440 W supplies are. (2) The weights table gives ONE row for all eight supplies, "2.64 lb (1.2 kg)", where the FX3P guide's row for its 1900 W supply is 3.6 lb (1.63 kg) (the component's weight). The PH row is carried in this device's weight note only; no weight is put on the component.

the-width.note: The guide's Switch Dimensions table (PDF p54, printed 48): "17.3 inches (43.9 cm)" wide, "1.72 inches (4.4 cm) (1 RU)" high, and for depth "Chassis without PSUs - 18.0 in (45.72 cm)", "With NXA-PAC-350W PSUs - 19.7 in (49.9 cm)", "With NXA-PHV-350W PSUs - 19.7 in (49.9 cm)", "With NXA-PDC-440W PSUs - 21.0 in (53.34 cm)" and "With NXA-PAC-1900W PSUs - 21.1 in (53.6 cm)". The chassis depth carried is the first, 457.2 mm: the library's depth is the chassis, and the others include the modules. 439.4 mm and 43.7 mm are carried, the inch figures converted. The weights table on the same page gives this chassis "14.33 lb (6.49 kg)"; this is the PH's own row (the 9348GC-FX3's is 14.5 lb, 6.57 kg).

the-x-axis.note: From the front figure, origin the left end line. FOUR boxed groups of six jack columns: the box lines start at 15.0, 105.0, 195.0 and 285.0 mm, a stride of 90.0, and the jacks stand 2.7 mm inside each box, so the columns start at 17.55, 107.55, 197.55 and 287.55 mm (the figure's jack outline is 12.2 wide against the registry's 12.7, centred). At the registry's 13.97 mm pitch the stride is a gutter of 6.2 mm. The two SFP28 columns' boxes start at 376.1 and 390.9 mm, a 14.65 mm step, and the QSFP28 pair at 409.9 mm.

the-y-axis.note: From the same figure, origin the top line. The upper jack's centre is at 15.25 mm and the lower jack's at 29.9, a 14.6 mm row pitch; with the registry's 11.0 high cell the upper jack runs 9.75 to 20.75 mm. The SFP28 boxes run 9.5 to 19.3 and 25.2 to 34.8 mm and the QSFP28 boxes 9.2 to 19.2 and 25.6 to 35.2. THE PORT LAMPS ARE SMALL RECTANGLES BELOW THE JACKS, one under each port, about 4.1 by 2.8 mm in the figure, so common/led-rect@1 (4.6 x 2.6), two to a column, the left one for the upper port, at 38.3 mm; the numerals and a pair of arrows stand above them, the numerals' baseline at 37.65 mm.
